metadata.bug: Selects the live match_pattern for comparison on the cycle latch_pattern is asserted, instead of comparing only against the previously latched pattern.
metadata.trigger: On an enabled clock edge with latch_pattern=1, the registered masked_data_in equals match_pattern & mask but differs from latched_pattern & mask. For example, with mask=8'hFF, masked_data_in=8'hA5, match_pattern=8'hA5, and latched_pattern=8'h00, the mutant sets match_detected; the original does not.
metadata.effect: Creates a false match indication for the old latched pattern; pattern_match_pulse can assert on the following enabled cycle even though the new pattern was only being latched on the triggering edge.

witness_method: mixed-driver search normalization, confirmed on unchanged Icarus RTL
